entries.title: Enter assembly quantities in pieces
entries.description: Assembly quantities for parts measured in millimetres now clearly show a piece count and the standard length of each piece. Length labels are easier to read.

entries.title: Distinguish cancellations from warnings
entries.description: Cancelled items now use red status badges.

entries.title: Use simpler control styling
entries.description: Focused fields, buttons, and other controls no longer show extra highlight rings. Validation errors remain highlighted.

entries.title: Spot cancelled jobs in the bay schedule
entries.description: Cancelled job badges now appear in red.
